purpose: Host-only prospective interpretation of the original q002/q003 grading contracts; no execution authorization and no historical regrading.
selection: Retain the original two-task selection as a whole and every outcome. Historical runs remain unchanged and reported separately from any future native phase; no favorable-subset selection.
distribution: Host review/grading only. Never copy this file, rubric, reference answer, provenance or prior results into solver source, image, MCP index, system/user prompt or agent guidance. This draft does not apply to the current q001 confirmation.
common_rules: Freeze the final host contract before any future expansion answer is seen. Use randomized exact-byte final answers, the corresponding original question/rubric and frozen pre-fix source; exclude condition/pair labels, resource metrics, trajectories and prior answers/scores from the grader packet.

The pinned rubric remains authoritative for points, success gates, partial credit, contradictions and evidence. Keep maximum10/minimum8 and the original task-specific core requirements. Use integer points only; equivalent correct causal wording and sufficient source spans are accepted.

Score the final answer, not retrieved context. A cited range containing an omitted explanation does not supply that explanation. Do not add q001 error-handling, exact patch syntax, execution, or originally optional test variants as requirements.

Record factual points separately from core citation validity and substantiated contradictions. Missing coverage follows original partial/zero and mandatory-core rules; omission alone is not an affirmative contradiction. Preserve each rubric’s explicit contradiction rules.
Label the reviewer accurately; model review is not official SWE-QA or human grading. Preserve the source-inference versus executed-validation distinction.

q002.core: C1, C2 and C4 each require 2/2 and supporting actual pre-fix citations; zero critical contradictions. C1/C2 anchors remain unchanged.

C3.scores: 0, 1 or 2; add the two original one-point groups without half-points.
C3.group_1: Scalar-only query obtains no rows from the empty inverted iterator.
C3.group_2: Explain unindexed forward-predicate preservation and how meaningful nonempty restrictions account for the reported positive and disjoint controls. One shared causal explanation may cover both outcomes; merely repeating expected ID sets is insufficient.
C3.interpretation: The second point’s compound controls are considered together. Do not require every positive/disjoint control to use candidate extraction: retained bitmap and forward evaluation are valid. Exact threshold constants are supporting detail, not an additional scored requirement.

C4.full_2: Explain a source-grounded end-to-end repair preserving absent/unrestricted, explicit-empty/reject-all and nonempty/restricted search, the consumed-filter handoff, and ordinary unfiltered plus remaining delete/forward semantics. An equivalent safe computed-zero short-circuit before constraint loss is accepted.
C4.partial_1: Apply the original partial anchor: special zero-result handling is proposed but preservation of the ordinary unrestricted path or consumed-filter handoff is not established. Also award1 when a source-grounded three-state/handoff repair is otherwise correct but preservation of remaining delete/forward constraints is unexplained. This is incomplete repair reasoning, not full credit. A pointer-only bitmap change cannot earn full credit; original critical-contradiction rules still apply.
C4.zero_0: No supported repair or a materially incorrect repair. The partial point requires a correct, source-grounded component, not merely naming optional candidates.
C4.interpretation: Preservation can be established through an explicit unchanged-filter path or equivalent causal reasoning; exact delete/forward keywords or patch syntax are not required. Do not supply missing semantics from reviewer-added code. No new failure-propagation requirement is added.
C4.prospective_host_boundary: Before any new native q002 answer, the host assigns1 to the otherwise-correct repair that omits only remaining delete/forward preservation. This applies the original partial-credit idea symmetrically to an incomplete preservation explanation. Full2 and mandatory C4 still require every original full-credit element. Historical grades are unchanged.

C5.scores: 0, 1 or 2; add the two original one-point groups without half-points.
C5.group_1: End-to-end zero-match indexed scalar plus matching FTS with expected empty IDs, together with a scalar-only or unindexed control.
C5.group_2: Explicit no-scalar-restriction, nonempty-overlap and nonempty-disjoint expectations that preserve valid results/topk/remaining-filter behavior.
C5.interpretation: A described regression is sufficient. Do not require execution, upstream test names, or an additional matrix of topk sizes. Partial credit requires one complete original group, not a generic suggestion to add tests.

q003.application: Use existing integer point units verbatim. Full C2 requires both maintenance_branch units, including existing FLAT memory/persisted storage versus the initially unbuilt requested HNSW index. Full C3 requires both broken_mapping units, including retained physical forward/doc_ids and block metadata. Do not substitute a shortened criterion summary for these requirements.
q003.core_citations: For every C2/C3 point unit record an actual answer citation, verified pre-fix location and how it supports the unit. Both units of each core criterion must pass. No literal curated-range requirement and no auditor-added or post-fix-only citation substitution.
q003.noncore: Apply C4-C8 compound single-point units and their stated optional exclusions as written. Preserve logical read filtering in C7 and the independent known-direction ID-plus-vector-payload oracle in C8. Do not add upsert, broad variant matrices, ideal-decimal exactly-30% behavior or universal ANN guarantees.
q003.disqualification: Follow the existing quotation, evidence and adjudication requirements. Namespace criterion IDs separately from contradiction/disqualification IDs because both use C1-C5. An explicit substantiated disqualifying assertion forces failure independently of points; omissions and unresolved wording follow the existing policy.

citation_origin.answer_cited: Record the exact answer quote/location and the path/line range the answer actually gives. A verifier’s wider contextual window is not automatically wholly answer-cited.
citation_origin.reviewer_added: Retain supplemental source verification separately with this label. It may explain the review but cannot supply missing final-answer coverage or core citation evidence.
citation_origin.preservation: Keep original answer and grader-report bytes. Any attribution correction is a separate annotated record, not a silent rewrite or opportunity to choose a different score.

draft_review_note: Host review accepts the q002 C3 compound control group and resolves the C4 incomplete-preservation case as1 prospectively. The contract remains a draft until a separate expansion decision freezes it. It is not retroactive and changes no rubric bytes or full-credit/core threshold.
